meta.title: Private Retreats at The Valley | Drift & Dwells
meta.description: Book the whole Valley privately for retreats, team gatherings, and intimate events. Check live availability and estimated lodging for all accommodations together.

hero.subhead: Book the whole off-grid valley privately for retreats, teams, families, and intimate events.

why.title: Why book the whole Valley
why.body: When you reserve the entire Valley, every A-frame, the Lux Cabin, and the Stone House are yours together. No shared bookings with other guests — just your group across the meadow, forest, and creek.

included.title: What is included
items: Exclusive use of all Valley accommodations for your dates
A-frame cabins, Lux Cabin, and Stone House together
Shared valley facilities: fire pit, communal kitchen areas, and gathering spaces
Starlink in communal areas (Stone House and shared spaces)
Off-grid setting with solar power and mountain silence

aframes.title: A-Frames
aframes.description: Minimal cabins immersed in the meadow — typically two guests per cabin.

lux.title: Lux Cabin
lux.description: Private cabin with full comfort, heating, and creek-side views.

stone.title: Stone House
stone.description: Historic stone house with generous shared living space and Starlink.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.body: Sleeping capacity depends on how your group uses each space. The quote below shows the maximum guests across all included accommodations. We can help you plan sleeping arrangements when you enquire.

quote.title: Availability & estimated price

quote.unavailable: The whole Valley is not available for these dates.
quote.disclaimer: Estimated lodging total. Transport, activities, food, and custom arrangements are quoted separately.
quote.subjectToConfirmation: Availability and price are subject to confirmation before booking.

idealFor.title: Ideal for
items: Small team offsites and creative residencies

logistics.title: Access & logistics
logistics.body: The Valley sits below Ortsevo in the Rhodope Mountains — remote, off-grid, and reached by jeep, horse, or hike from Chereshovo. We can arrange 4×4 transfer, guided horse ride, or hiking directions when you enquire. Food, catering, and on-site activities are quoted separately.

items.a: No. You submit a request with your dates and estimated lodging total. We confirm availability and details before anything is booked or held.

items.q: What if only part of the Valley is free?
items.a: Private retreat bookings require the entire Valley to be available. If any accommodation is booked or blocked, the whole location shows as unavailable for those dates.

items.q: What is included in the estimated price?
items.a: Lodging only — all included accommodations for your nights. Transport, meals, activities, and custom arrangements are quoted separately.

items.q: Can we book fewer than all accommodations?
items.a: This page is for exclusive use of the whole Valley. For individual stays, browse our separate accommodations on The Valley page.
